adolescence.definitionKo: 보통 십이 세부터 십팔 세 정도에 나타나는 육체적, 정신적으로 성인이 되어가는 시기.
adolescence.englishDescription: A period from age 12 to 18, when a child matures physically and mentally to become a grown-up.

adolescence.definitionKo: 열두 살에서 스무 살까지의 소년, 소녀일 때의 시기.
adolescence.englishDescription: The adolescent period between the ages of 12 and 20.

adolescence.definitionKo: 신체와 정신이 가장 왕성하게 발달한 20대 전후의 연령대.
adolescence.englishDescription: The time between one's early teenage years and early 20s when one's body and mind develop rapidly.

adolescence.definitionKo: 아동이 신체적 변화와 정체성의 혼란을 겪으며 성인이 되어 가는 도중의 시기.
adolescence.englishDescription: The period when a child's body and identity changes as he/she is becoming an adult.

anklet.definitionKo: 멋을 내기 위해 발목에 차는 둥근 모양의 장식품.
anklet.englishDescription: A round accessory for wearing on the ankle to dress up oneself.

attendee.englishDescription: A student who is taking a course or class.
A person who is taking a class or course.

automobile.definitionKo: 바퀴가 달려 있어 사람이나 짐을 실어 나르는 기관.
automobile.englishDescription: An apparatus with wheels that is designed to carry people or cargo.

automobile.definitionKo: 엔진의 힘으로 바퀴를 굴려서 도로 위를 움직이도록 만든 차.
automobile.englishDescription: A vehicle which moves its wheels by the power of its engine in order to run on roads.

bank.definitionKo: 바다나 강, 호수의 물과 닿아 있는 땅의 부분.
bank.englishDescription: The land adjoining an ocean, river or lake.

bank.definitionKo: 하천이나 호수의 물이 흘러넘치는 것을 막기 위해서 돌이나 흙 등으로 높이 막아 쌓은 긴 언덕.
bank.englishDescription: A long hill made of a pile of stones or soil, which is built to keep the water of streams or lakes from overflowing.

bank.definitionKo: 높은 길을 내려고 쌓은 긴 언덕.
bank.englishDescription: A long hill built to make an elevated road.

bank.definitionKo: 사람들의 돈을 맡아 관리하고 필요한 사람에게 돈을 빌려주는 기관.
bank.englishDescription: An institute that keeps and manages the money people have deposited and lends it to those who need it.

bank.definitionKo: 강이나 바다, 호수 등의 물이 넘쳐흐르는 것을 막기 위해 흙이나 돌, 콘크리트 등을 쌓아 만든 시설.
bank.englishDescription: A facility made of a pile of stones or soil, which is built to keep the water of rivers, seas, lakes, etc., from overflowing.

bulwark.definitionKo: 적의 공격이나 위협을 막기 위하여 쌓은 벽.
bulwark.englishDescription: A wall built to protect against an enemy's attack or threat.

cleanup.definitionKo: 일의 끝부분을 마무리 짓거나 일이 끝난 후 어지러운 것을 바르게 함.
cleanup.englishDescription: The act of finishing the last part of a work or cleaning up the mess after something has ended.

cleanup.definitionKo: 일이 끝나고 나서 남은 일을 마무리함.
cleanup.englishDescription: Finishing up the remaining work after the work is finished.
An act of eliminating something completely.

donghae.definitionKo: 한국의 동쪽에 있는 바다. 한국, 러시아의 연해주, 일본 등으로 둘러싸여 있다. 수심이 깊고 한류와 난류가 만나는 곳이라 어장이 발달하였다.
donghae.englishDescription: The sea to the east of Korea, also bordered by Russia's Maritime Province, Japan, etc.; fishery is developed due to a deep water level, and the meeting of warm and cold currents.

emphasize.englishDescription: To emphasize or confirm for thorough understanding.

emphasize.definitionKo: 어떤 것을 특히 두드러지게 하거나 강하게 주장하다.
emphasize.englishDescription: To make something emphasized or insist on something strongly.

indomitability.englishDescription: The attitude of not giving up despite all sorts of difficulties.

inefficiency.definitionKo: 들인 노력에 비해 성과가 만족스럽지 못함.
inefficiency.englishDescription: An unsatisfactory outcome compared to one's efforts.

malediction.definitionKo: 남을 헐뜯거나 남에게 나쁜 일이 일어나도록 저주하는 말.
malediction.englishDescription: A remark to criticize or wishing bad luck for someone.

miserable.definitionKo: 견딜 수 없을 정도로 슬프고 끔찍하다.

miserable.englishDescription: Appearing to make a poor living.

miserable.definitionKo: 몹시 무서워 떨릴 정도로 슬프고 끔찍하다.
miserable.englishDescription: Sad and dreadful to such a degree that one trembles out of fear.

miserable.definitionKo: 궁상맞고 처량하여 마음에 들지 않거나 보기에 좋지 않다.
miserable.englishDescription: Unattractive or unappealing because someone looks miserable and wretched, or something is shabby.

miserable.definitionKo: 궁상맞고 처량하여 마음에 들지 않거나 보기에 좋지 않은 데가 있다.
miserable.englishDescription: Unattractive or unappealing because someone looks miserable and wretched, or something is shabby.

mouse.definitionKo: 책상 위에 올려 두고 손으로 잡아 끌거나 눌러서 컴퓨터를 작동시키는 장치.
mouse.englishDescription: A computer device set on top of a desk that fits in the palm of the hand and which is used to move, drag or click the cursor on the computer screen.

mouse.definitionKo: 사람이 사는 곳 주변에 살고 움직임이 재빠른 작은 쥐.
mouse.englishDescription: A small and quick-moving rodent which lives in or around houses.

mouse.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 못된 짓을 저지르고도 약삭빠르게 빠져나가는 사람.
mouse.englishDescription: (figurative) A cunning  person who is good at weaseling out of responsibility for his/her wrongdoings.

mouse.definitionKo: 검은색, 회색, 짙은 갈색 털에 몸이 작으며 가늘고 긴 꼬리가 있는 쥐.
mouse.englishDescription: A small-sized mouse with a long, thin tail and black, grey, dark brown fur.

mouse.definitionKo: 사람의 집 근처 어두운 곳에서 살며 몸은 진한 회색에 긴 꼬리를 가지고 있는 작은 동물.
mouse.englishDescription: A small rodent with a dark gray coat and a long tail that lives in a dark place, often near a human's house.

pitch.definitionKo: 높이가 다른 두 음의 높낮이 차이.
pitch.englishDescription: The difference in height between the two notes having different heights.
The degree of highness or lowness of each note.

plateau.englishDescription: A large field at a high altitude.

plateau.definitionKo: 변하거나 흔들리지 않고 일정한 상태를 유지하는 기간.
plateau.englishDescription: The period in which things remain in a certain state, not changed or shaken.

plateau.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상황 등이 성장하거나 발전하지 못하고 일정한 정도에 그쳐 있는 시기.
plateau.englishDescription: A period where an affair, situation, etc., fails to progress or develop and remains in a certain state.

practice.definitionKo: 이론이나 계획, 생각한 것을 실제 행동으로 옮김.
practice.englishDescription: The act of putting one's theory, plan, thought, etc. into action.

practice.definitionKo: 이론이나 계획, 생각한 것을 실제 행동으로 옮기다.
practice.englishDescription: To put one's theory, plan, thought, etc., into action.

practice.definitionKo: 몸, 마음, 지식, 기술 등을 힘써 다스리거나 익힘.
practice.englishDescription: The act of disciplining one's body and mind or acquiring knowledge, skills, etc.

practice.definitionKo: 자주 경험하여 조금도 서투르지 않게 하다.
practice.englishDescription: To make oneself good at something by experiencing it repeatedly.
The act of making oneself familiar with something by doing it repeatedly as if in a real situation.

practice.definitionKo: 사회에서 어떤 일을 할 때 습관처럼 따르는, 오래 전부터 일을 하던 방식.
practice.englishDescription: The customary way of doing something in a society that has continued for a long time.
To pursue learning or learn and master a technique.

practice.definitionKo: 인격, 기술, 학문 등을 열심히 배우고 익힘.
practice.englishDescription: The act of learning and familiarizing oneself with a personality, technique, study, etc.

practice.definitionKo: 인격, 기술, 학문 등을 열심히 배우고 익히다.
practice.englishDescription: To learn and familiarize oneself with a personality, technique, study, etc.
The act of carrying out something.

practice.definitionKo: 몸, 마음, 지식, 기술 등을 힘써 다스리거나 익히다.
practice.englishDescription: To discipline one's body and mind or acquire knowledge, skills, etc.
To make oneself familiar with something by doing it repeatedly as if in a real situation.

practice.englishExpression: fulfill; practice; bring something into action
practice.englishDescription: To put one's thoughts or resolution into action.

practice.definitionKo: 무엇을 잘할 수 있도록 반복하여 익히다.
practice.englishDescription: To do something repeatedly in order to be good at it.

practice.definitionKo: 무엇을 잘할 수 있도록 반복하여 익힘.
practice.englishDescription: The act of doing something repeatedly in order to be good at it.

recoil.definitionKo: 어떤 힘이나 움직임에 대하여 그 반대로 움직임.
recoil.englishDescription: The act of moving against a certain force or movement.
To shrink suddenly, repeatedly with fright.
To shrink suddenly, repeatedly with fright.
To shrink suddenly, repeatedly with fright.
